caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular scene with several objects and figures arranged horizontally. On the left side, there is a woman dressed in a blue dress and a light-colored hat, holding a staff or stick, seated beside a large white goat and several small white sheep. To her right, there is a seated man in gray clothing and a gray hat, with a red object (possibly a hat) on the ground near his feet and a white dog lying beside him. Between the man and woman is a large pink and green flower on a stem. On either side of the figures are green palm-like trees. Above, there are symmetrical red and pink flower arrangements in white vases, a red-and-blue geometric motif, and several pink and white birds flying or perched. The right side of the drawing is occupied by a large red house with a white roof, black-and-white window patterns, a light brown door, and blue decorations along the bottom. Above the house, more white birds are depicted. The ground beneath the people and animals is represented by a brown area that extends the width of the scene. A row of small, red-and-green flowers in a linear pattern runs along the bottom edge. The text "Susanna Lawton Finished This Work 1844" is stitched in black thread near the bottom center of the piece. The background of the entire drawing is off-white, and the figures and objects are rendered in a stitch style, typical of a sampler.
title: Sampler
